raw.details:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering proposes to host Zinnovatio 4.0 – Gen Z Innovations Hackathon on 30-31 oct, 2026. This National-level flagship event will bring together creative and technically skilled minds from diverse engineering disciplines to collaboratively design solutions for real-world challenges.

The hackathon will be organized in a hybrid format, beginning with online screening rounds and culminating in an offline final showcase.

Key Objectives:

  • Foster Creative Thinking: Motivate participants to explore emerging technologies and craft impactful solutions.
  • Build Problem-Solving Competence: Present challenging problem statements to enhance analytical, coding, and design capabilities.
  • Encourage Collaborative Learning: Facilitate teamwork, interdisciplinary exchange, and networking with like-minded innovators.
  • Enable Industry Connect: Provide mentorship and interaction with industry leaders and potential recruiters.
  • Transform Ideas into Prototypes: Support teams in turning innovative concepts into working models.

Key Outcomes:

  • Students gained hands-on experience by working with new technologies and exploring innovative solutions that are applicable in today’s industries.
  • They had the opportunity to connect and network with industry experts, mentors, and fellow participants, which helped broaden their professional relationships.
  • Their technical knowledge, problem-solving abilities, and collaboration skills were enhanced through interactive sessions and practical exercises.

Tracks for Hackathon (Tentative)

  • Smart & Sustainable Cities

Urban innovation for better governance, digital services, smart mobility, clean air, waste management, and disaster resilience.

Focus: IoT, Geospatial tech, AI, CivicTech, e-governance.

  • AgriTech & Rural Transformation

Enhancing farmers’ income and rural livelihoods through technology in agriculture, water use, supply chains, and rural MSMEs.

Focus: Precision farming, drones, soil health, rural fintech.

  • Healthcare, Wellbeing & Assistive Technologies

Affordable, accessible health solutions including preventive care, digital health, mental wellness, and devices for special needs.

Focus: Telemedicine, Med-AI, prosthetics, mental health apps.

  • Education, Skilling & Future of Work

Reimagining education delivery, personalized learning, employability, and lifelong skilling per NEP-2020.

Focus: EdTech, VR/AR learning tools, AI tutors, skill marketplaces.

  • Energy, Environment & Climate Action

Innovations for clean energy, sustainability, climate resilience, and conservation.

Focus: Renewable energy, carbon capture, EV, circular economy.

  • Defence, Aerospace & National Security

Indigenous solutions in aerospace, defence logistics, cybersecurity, and border security.

Focus: Drones, satellite tech, secure comms, surveillance.

Phase 1- Submission Link
https://forms.gle/xiCJ1d3LbPcbTKHv8

Event Details:

  • Dates: 30-31 Oct, 2026
  • Venue: Chandigarh University, Mohali 
  • Duration: 2 Days(Overnight)
